zones.name: Loot: Armor

zones.desc: Destination for artifacts.

zones.name: Loot: Bionics
zones.desc: Destination for Compact Bionics Modules, a.k.a. CBMs.

zones.name: Loot: Books
zones.desc: Destination for books and magazines.

zones.name: Loot: Chemical
zones.desc: Destination for chemicals.

zones.name: Loot: Clothing
zones.desc: Destination for clothing.  Does include filthy clothing if such zone is not specified.

zones.name: Loot: Containers
zones.desc: Destination for empty containers.

zones.name: Loot: Corpses
zones.desc: Destination for corpses.

zones.name: Loot: Currency
zones.desc: Destination for currency.

zones.name: Loot: Custom
zones.desc: Destination for loot with a custom filter that you can modify.

zones.name: Loot: Default
zones.desc: Destination for any loot without a more specific zone defined.

zones.name: Loot: Drink
zones.desc: Destination for drinks.  Does include perishable drinks if such zone is not specified.

zones.name: Loot: Drugs
zones.desc: Destination for drugs and other medical items.

zones.name: Loot: Filthy Armor
zones.desc: Destination for filthy armor.

zones.name: Loot: Filthy Clothing
zones.desc: Destination for filthy clothing.

zones.name: Loot: Food
zones.desc: Destination for comestibles.  If more specific food zone is not defined, all food is moved here.

zones.name: Loot: Fuel
zones.desc: Destination for gasoline, diesel, kerosene and other substances used as a fuel.

zones.name: Loot: Guns
zones.desc: Destination for guns, bows and similar weapons.

zones.name: Loot: Ignore
zones.desc: Items inside of this zone are ignored by "sort out loot" zone-action.

zones.name: Loot: Ignore Favorites
zones.desc: Favorite items inside of this zone are ignored by "sort out loot" zone-action.

zones.name: Loot: Item Group
zones.desc: Destination for items from an item group.

zones.name: Loot: Keys
zones.desc: Destination for keys.

zones.name: Loot: Magazines
zones.desc: Destination for gun magazines.

zones.name: Loot: Manuals
zones.desc: Destination for instructional books and magazines.

zones.name: Loot: Maps
zones.desc: Destination for maps.

zones.name: Loot: Martial arts manuals
zones.desc: Destination for manuals for martial arts.

zones.name: Loot: Mods
zones.desc: Destination for firearm modifications and similar items.

zones.name: Loot: Mutagens
zones.desc: Destination for mutagens, serums, and purifiers.

zones.name: Loot: Other
zones.desc: Destination for other miscellaneous items.

zones.name: Loot: Perishable Drink
zones.desc: Destination for perishable drinks.

zones.name: Loot: Perishable Food
zones.desc: Destination for perishable comestibles.  Does include perishable drinks if such zone is not specified.

zones.name: Loot: Seeds
zones.desc: Destination for seeds, stems and similar items.

zones.name: Loot: Spare Parts
zones.desc: Destination for spare parts.

zones.name: Loot: Tool Magazines
zones.desc: Destination for tool magazines.

zones.name: Loot: Tools
zones.desc: Destination for tools.

zones.name: Loot: Traps
zones.desc: Destination for traps.

zones.name: Loot: Unsorted
zones.desc: Place to drop unsorted loot.  You can use "sort out loot" zone-action to sort items inside.  It can overlap with Loot zones of different types.

zones.name: Loot: Vehicle Parts
zones.desc: Destination for vehicle parts.

zones.name: Loot: Weapons
zones.desc: Destination for melee weapons.

zones.name: Loot: Wood
zones.desc: Destination for firewood and items that can be used as such.

zones.name: Loot: Strip Corpses
zones.desc: Corpses in this zone you don't otherwise sort will have everything taken off them and dropped on the same tile.

zones.name: Loot: Unload Everything
zones.desc: Any containers in this zone you don't otherwise sort will have their contents dumped out and placed on the same tile.  This includes corpses, magazines, and magazine wells.

zones.name: Auto Drink
zones.desc: Items in this zone will be automatically consumed during a long activity if you get thirsty.

zones.name: Auto Eat
zones.desc: Items in this zone will be automatically eaten during a long activity if you get hungry.

zones.name: Basecamp: Food
zones.desc: Items in this zone will be added to a basecamp's food supply in the Distribute Food mission.

zones.name: Basecamp: Storage
zones.desc: Items in this zone will be added to a basecamp's inventory for use by its workers.

zones.name: Chop Trees
zones.desc: Designate an area to chop down trees.

zones.name: Construction: Blueprint
zones.desc: Designate a blueprint zone for construction.

zones.name: Disassembly Work
zones.desc: Items in this zone are marked for disassembly.

zones.name: Farm: Plot
zones.desc: Designate a farm plot for tilling and planting.

zones.name: Fishing Spot
zones.desc: Designate an area to fish from.

zones.name: Mine Terrain
zones.desc: Designate an area to mine.

zones.name: Mop Tile
zones.desc: Designate an area to mop clean.

zones.name: No Auto Pickup
zones.desc: You won't auto-pickup items inside the zone.

zones.name: No NPC Pickup
zones.desc: Friendly NPCs don't pickup items inside the zone.

zones.name: NPC Ignore Sounds
zones.desc: Friendly NPCs won't investigate unseen sounds coming from this zone.

zones.name: NPC Investigation Area
zones.desc: Friendly NPCs will investigate unseen sounds only if they come from inside this area.

zones.name: NPC Retreat
zones.desc: When fleeing, friendly NPCs will attempt to retreat toward this zone if it is within 60 tiles.

zones.name: Start Point
zones.desc: A prioritized spawn point.

zones.name: Source: Firewood
zones.desc: Source for firewood or other flammable materials in this zone may be used to automatically refuel fires.  This will be done to maintain light during long-running tasks such as crafting, reading or waiting.

zones.name: Vehicle Deconstruct Zone
zones.desc: Any vehicles in this area are marked for deconstruction.

zones.name: Vehicle Patrol Zone
zones.desc: Vehicles with an autopilot will patrol in this zone.

zones.name: Vehicle Repair Zone
zones.desc: Any vehicles in this area are marked for repair work.
